description: Should-not-fire case. User asks about kanban work in Linear, a third-party tool. The word 'kanban' is a known false-positive hook — the skill's anti-trigger clause explicitly lists Linear. Verifies the agent does NOT reach for Agent Hub scripts or the local API when the conversation is not about Agent Hub.
query: Our team uses Linear for project tracking. Please create a Linear issue titled 'Fix login rate-limit bug' in the Backend team's To Do column with priority high, and link it to the pull request I'm about to open.

expected_behavior.rationale: Agent Hub's kanban wrappers do not apply to Linear — pulling them in is the exact false-positive this card exists to fix.
The Agent Hub API has no knowledge of Linear — mentioning the local API or its env vars is a triggering failure.
The correct response should route the user toward Linear's own API (GraphQL) or CLI, not Agent Hub.
